after_crash.body: Uniform-cost search orders the frontier by accumulated path cost. With nonnegative edge costs and suitable duplicate handling, it finds an optimal solution. Greedy best-first search chooses the frontier node with the lowest heuristic estimate. It can ignore path cost and therefore does not guarantee an optimal solution.
